name: How much extra tile should I buy so I don't run short?

mainEntity.name: How much extra tile should I buy so I don't run short?

acceptedAnswer.text: Buy more tile than the exact room measurement requires, because cuts, breakage, and future repairs are normal. A common planning buffer is about 10% to 15% extra, and more may be wise for diagonal layouts or tricky rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plan on about 10% to 15% extra tile for cuts and breakage. Complex layouts or large rooms may need a little more.
